<thought>We will search the template catalog using only functional group criteria to find a carbonyl‑ene retrosynthetic template. The forward reaction breaks a ketone and a C‑C double bond and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCCC1(OH)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
